tests.scenario: Launch app and access guided meditation session without login or subscription within 30 seconds
steps: Launch the meditation app
Verify the app's main screen is displayed
Select the option to start a guided meditation session
Verify the guided meditation session starts within 30 seconds
tests.expected_result: The guided meditation session begins playing within 30 seconds of launching the app, without prompting for login or subscription

tests.scenario: Validate guided meditation session accessibility from home screen
steps: Navigate to the home screen
Access the meditation sessions menu
Select a guided meditation session
tests.expected_result: The guided meditation session starts playing within 3 navigation steps

tests.scenario: Validate navigation menu accessibility within 3 clicks
steps: Log in to the system
Access the main navigation menu
Navigate to a main feature (e.g., user management) in 3 clicks or less
tests.expected_result: The main feature (e.g., user management) is displayed and accessible within 3 clicks from the main navigation menu

tests.scenario: Validate navigation to shopping cart within 3 clicks from any product page
steps: Navigate to a product page
Click on a product to view details
Click on the 'Add to Cart' button
Click on the 'View Cart' button
tests.expected_result: The system navigates to the shopping cart page and displays the added product

tests.scenario: Validate uninterrupted relaxation sessions for users
steps: Simulate 100 user sessions with relaxation mode enabled
Introduce random interruptions (max 2 per session) with duration (max 30 seconds) during the sessions for 15 users
Measure the number of uninterrupted sessions and interruptions per session for the remaining 85 users

tests.scenario: Validate uninterrupted relaxation session for 30 minutes
steps: Start a relaxation session
Wait for 30 minutes without any interactions
Verify no unexpected interruptions or alerts occur during the session
tests.expected_result: The relaxation session completes without any interruptions or alerts for the full 30 minutes

tests.scenario: Validate upfront display of all costs associated with a subscription
steps: Navigate to the subscription purchase page
Select a subscription plan
Review the displayed costs and breakdown of charges
tests.expected_result: The system displays a clear and detailed breakdown of all costs associated with the subscription, including no hidden fees, in a transparent and easily understandable format.

tests.scenario: Validate clear display of subscription costs during onboarding
steps: Initiate the onboarding process for a new subscription
Select a subscription plan and proceed to the payment details page
Review the costs and fees associated with the subscription
tests.expected_result: The system displays a detailed breakdown of all costs, including any potential hidden fees, in a clear and readable format.

tests.scenario: Validate guided relaxation session helps users fall asleep within 20 minutes
steps: Start a new guided relaxation session
Begin timer to track session duration
Follow the guided relaxation session instructions
Indicate when the user falls asleep (e.g., via a 'fallen asleep' button)
tests.expected_result: The user falls asleep within 20 minutes of starting the session, and the system records the session duration as less than or equal to 20 minutes.

tests.scenario: Validation of guided relaxation session effectiveness
steps: User starts a guided relaxation session
User uses the session at least 3 times a week for a period of 2 weeks
Track and record the number of sessions where user falls asleep within 30 minutes
Calculate the success rate of falling asleep within 30 minutes

output.message: The system provides a guided relaxation session with an 80% success rate of users falling asleep within 30 minutes
